question: Who among the following succeeded the throne of the Mauryan Empire after the death of Chandragupta Maurya?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bindusara**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bindusara** was** the son of Chandragupta Maurya** and was** the second ruler of the Mauryan Empire**.
 
• Bindusara ruled the Mauryan Empire from 298 BCE to 272 BCE and expanded the empire to include parts of present-day Afghanistan and southern India.
